ma.scanCode(Object object)

The onHide and onShow life cycle functions of the app and page are executed. The process is as follows: app.onHide > page.onHide > (return) app.onShow > page.onShow. (The simulator is implemented only for simulation.)

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
onlyFromCamera Boolean false No Whether to use only the camera without selecting pictures from albums
scanType Array ['barCode', 'qrCode'] No Scan Code Type
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Valid value of object.scanType

Value Description
barCode one-dimensional code
qrCode QR code
datamatrix Data Matrix Code
pdf417 PDF417 Barcode

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String Code scanning success information
result String Content of the scanned code
scanType String Type of code to be scanned

Sample Code

// Allow scanning from camera and album.
ma.scanCode({
  success(res) {
    console.log(res);
  }
});

// Scan code from camera only.
ma.scanCode({
  onlyFromCamera: true,
  success(res) {
    console.log(res);
  }
});
